p2g2.body: Bestcom Working Process. Stage 1: Bestcom system carries out further analysis in order to find [[20]] about what users are doing. The flow then splits into 'in the office' and 'out of the office'. In the office, two branches: (a) Check the [[21]] between the caller and the user, whether the caller has contact information of the user, such as their family, friends or collegues. (b) If callers are not in directory, a(n) [[22]] will show up on their screen, saying the user is not available at moment. The system will [[23]] a suitable time for both, or callers can choose to leave a(n) [[24]] to users. Out of the office: Bestcom will provide a solution by transferring your call to the user's [[25]] if there is no [[26]] in his or her schedule.
